$description: Login gate token ledger - the colours the login surface ships, in the Design Tokens Community Group format. Every token here is a CSS custom property declared on .login-page / .dark .login-page in src/app/globals.css. Each $description carries its measured WCAG ratio AND names the ground that ratio holds against, because the same token measures differently on the page sky, on the card and on a field fill. Ratios are computed, never rounded up, by tests/unit/login-contrast.test.js - which re-derives every one of them from the stylesheet and turns red the moment a comment here or in the CSS disagrees with the arithmetic. APCA is NOT reported: nothing in this repository computes it, and an unverified number in a ledger is worse than an absent one. CORRECTED 2026-10-02: this file still carried the coral-era retheme's residue - RGB components and ratios left over from the palette that preceded the shore-blue ground, sitting under blue hexes, disagreeing with the CSS comments and with the arithmetic. Every entry below was re-derived; the field border split per shore because one grey cannot clear the floor on both grounds.

cta.$description: Primary CTA fill, both themes (= brand-700). White label text = 7.87:1. Replaces brand-500 (#2E7CF6), which gave white text only 3.23:1 - a FAIL.

cta-hover.$description: CTA hover fill (= brand-800). White label text = 10.72:1. Deepens on hover, so the accent stays singular while the pressed state reads.

field-border-light.$description: Light-theme input boundary. 3.93:1 against the light field fill #F1F3F7 (SC 1.4.11 floor 3:1). The shared Input's own border-strong measured 3.13:1 on that fill.

field-border-dark.$description: Dark-theme input boundary. 3.77:1 against the dark field fill #20304E. A single shared grey could not hold: #6B7B87 measured 3.02:1 on this fill - one rounding from the floor - which is why the token is split per shore. (A single value cannot clear 3:1 on both grounds at once: the geometric optimum is ~3.44:1 on each, measured.)

focus-ring-light.$description: Light-theme focus indicator (= brand-500). 3.55:1 vs the field fill #F1F3F7 (SC 1.4.11 floor 3:1, SC 2.4.13 appearance). 2px outline. Also the light stop of the field's focus glow.

focus-ring-dark.$description: Dark-theme focus indicator (= brand-400). 5.25:1 vs the field fill #20304E - the previous comment claimed 6.35:1, overstated by 1.1. Also the dark stop of the field's focus glow.

placeholder-light.$description: Light-theme placeholder. 5.40:1 vs the field fill #F1F3F7 (SC 1.4.3 floor 4.5; placeholder text is text).

placeholder-dark.$description: Dark-theme placeholder. 5.19:1 vs the field fill #20304E.

eyebrow-light.$description: Light-theme 'THE HARBOR GATE' eyebrow (= brand-700). 7.40:1 over the page. NOTE the ground: the eyebrow sits in the column ABOVE the card, so the page sky is its ground - not the card, which the previous entry claimed (and it named #12388A, a hex the CSS never used for it).

eyebrow-dark.$description: Dark-theme eyebrow (= brand-400). 6.73:1 over the page (previous claim 5.48:1 / 5.66:1 - both measured on the wrong ground).

feature-icon-light.$description: Light-theme feature-list glyphs (= brand-600). 4.79:1 over the page (icons are meaningful, floor 3:1). Previously absent from this ledger entirely.

feature-icon-dark.$description: Dark-theme feature-list glyphs (= brand-300, the crystal). 10.39:1 over the page. Replaces the brand-400/80 alpha form, whose 80% opacity dropped the icons toward the floor.

warn-light.$description: Light-theme warning copy (caps-lock, SSO incomplete, no-password risk). 4.73:1 on the card #F7F8FA (SC 1.4.3 pass at 12px).

warn-dark.$description: Dark-theme warning copy. 8.82:1 on the card #1A2842.

error-light.$description: Light-theme error copy, including the shared Input's own error slot. 6.09:1 on the card. The shared component's text-red-500 measured 3.73:1 - a FAIL at 12px.

error-dark.$description: Dark-theme error copy. 5.32:1 on the card #1A2842.

footer.$description: Footer status line and constellation caption, 11px. An ALIAS: resolves to --color-text-muted - #5A6472 light, #98A2B3 dark. Light 5.65:1 over the page, dark 6.55:1. The previous entry named #6b7280, a grey the stylesheet does not use. Replaces --color-text-subtle, which gave 2.52:1 (light) and 3.37:1 (dark) - both FAIL at 11px.

status-dot-light.$description: Light-theme gateway-status dot, 7px of pure non-text signal (SC 1.4.11, floor 3:1). 5.16:1 on the light page #F7F8FA; 4.86:1 at the sky gradient's foot (#EAF2FC), the worst of its grounds. Replaces the shared --color-success (#10b981), which gave 2.44:1 - a FAIL. Scoped to the gate rather than darkened globally, so no success badge elsewhere in the dashboard is repainted for a login-page finding.

status-dot-dark.$description: Dark-theme gateway-status dot - the dark-theme --color-success, kept. NOTE the two greens differ: --color-success is declared twice (#10B981 light, #22c55e dark), and assuming one hex for both is exactly how a false ratio gets written. Its ground is the gate's night sky: 7.41:1 on #121D30, 7.39:1 at the sky's crown (#0B1E33). Both clear the 3:1 floor.
